about: A jet's cockpit as chapter 1 describes it (modern-iaf/docs/manuals.md §2): per panel its controls, each by its node in the cockpit's control table (shared/extra/models/cockpit3d/<cockpit>.json): label as on the panel, name (the words behind the initials), positions (optional; their count is checked against the control table, which gives the count when they are left out), does (the real jet, from the panel's source), sim (what the sim does with it and what stops working while it is off; modern-iaf/docs/cockpit.md §5.2; none: the layout says whether the control works a system, from the control table). abbreviations: every abbreviation the manual uses, with its full name: the Abbreviations appendix, and the brackets at an abbreviation's first use in a chapter's steps. short: everyday shortenings, listed in the appendix only. words: plain words the panels write in capitals. tools/manuals.py stops the build on a capital token that is in none of the three.

abbreviations.RPM: Revolutions per minute, shown in percent
abbreviations.ICAWS: Integrated caution, advisory and warning system

short.MIL: Military power, full power without the afterburner

controls.label: BATT
controls.name: Battery
controls.does: Connects the battery: the first of the start's three switch selections.
controls.sim: OFF and RESET: no power; the lamps and the display are dark. ON: the lamps come alive and the 90-second self test starts. RESET moves the switch and counts as off.

controls.label: IPP
controls.name: Integrated power pack
controls.does: Starts the IPP, the small turbine that powers the jet on the ground and turns the engine: the second selection.
controls.sim: Up to speed 10 seconds after ON; the display lights 3 seconds later on its power. Off during a crank: the crank stops.

controls.label: START
controls.name: Start mode
controls.does: The start system's mode knob.
controls.sim: Works the start's crank of the engine by the IPP.

controls.label: ICC1
controls.name: Inverter converter controller 1
controls.does: Connects the first of the two units that turn the engine's starter-generator into the jet's electrical power.

controls.label: ICC2
controls.name: Inverter converter controller 2
controls.does: Connects the second of the two units.

controls.label: CABIN PRESS
controls.name: Cabin pressure
controls.does: Sets the cabin's pressure: let out, held by the system, or held by the alternate control.

controls.label: Guard
controls.name: IPP emergency off guard
controls.does: Covers the IPP EMER OFF button.

controls.label: IPP EMER OFF
controls.name: IPP emergency off
controls.does: Stops the IPP at once.

controls.label: Guard
controls.name: Engine switch guard
controls.does: Covers the ENG switch.
controls.sim: The ENG switch moves only with the guard open.

controls.label: ENG
controls.name: Engine
controls.does: Starts the engine: the third selection. The engine control runs the start by itself. A guard covers the switch.
controls.sim: NORM with the IPP up to speed: the engine runs up to idle in about 35 seconds. OFF: the fuel is cut and the engine winds down. MOTOR moves the switch and counts as off (dry motoring is not modelled).

controls.label: VS BIT
controls.name: Vehicle systems built-in test
controls.does: Starts the self test of the jet's systems.

controls.label: FRICTION
controls.name: Throttle friction
controls.does: Sets how stiffly the throttle moves.

controls.label: THROTTLE
controls.name: Throttle active or backup
controls.does: Chooses the throttle's normal or backup channel.

controls.label: Throttle
controls.name: Throttle
controls.does: Sets the engine's thrust.
controls.sim: Moves with the throttle keys and a throttle lever; the pointer does not move it.

controls.label: FCS RESET
controls.name: Flight control system reset
controls.does: Pressed, clears the flight control system's stored faults before take-off.
controls.sim: The button moves; no fault is stored to clear.

controls.label: CANOPY
controls.name: Canopy lever
controls.does: Forward lowers and locks the canopy; aft opens it.
controls.sim: One click, or its key, moves the lever; the canopy takes about 10 seconds. The lever's place and shape are inferred.

controls.label: DEFOG
controls.name: Canopy defog
controls.does: Blows warm air onto the canopy.

controls.label: Landing gear handle
controls.name: Landing gear handle
controls.does: DN lowers the landing gear, UP raises it.

controls.label: Handle light
controls.name: Gear handle warning light
controls.does: Red while the gear is moving or does not agree with the handle.
controls.sim: On while a leg is not where the handle is.

controls.label: Guard
controls.name: Alternate gear guard
controls.does: Covers the ALT GEAR handle.
controls.sim: The handle moves only with the guard open.

controls.label: ALT GEAR
controls.name: Alternate gear extension
controls.does: A guarded handle that lowers the landing gear when the normal system cannot.
controls.sim: Not modelled: the guard and the handle move.

controls.label: PARKING BRAKE
controls.name: Parking brake
controls.does: Holds the wheel brakes on while the jet is parked.

controls.label: LAND/TAXI LIGHTS
controls.name: Landing and taxi lights
controls.does: Turns on the taxi light or the landing light.

controls.label: JETTISON
controls.name: Jettison select
controls.does: Chooses what the jettison button drops: ALL the stores or the external ones (EXT).

controls.label: Jettison button
controls.name: Emergency jettison
controls.does: Drops the stores the knob around it selects.

controls.label: HOOK
controls.name: Arresting hook
controls.does: Lowers the hook that catches a runway's arresting cable.

controls.label: PCD
controls.name: Panoramic cockpit display
controls.does: One touch screen across the panel: the flight data, the sensors, the stores, the engine and the fuel, in windows.

controls.label: MASTER CAUTION
controls.name: Master caution light and reset
controls.does: Lights with any caution. Pressed, it goes out and is ready for the next one.

controls.label: ENG FIRE
controls.name: Engine fire light
controls.does: Red with a fire in the engine bay; pushed, it arms the fire extinguisher.

controls.label: AUTO REC
controls.name: Automatic recovery
controls.does: Lets the flight control system bring the jet back to level flight by itself.

controls.label: ZEROIZE
controls.name: Zeroize
controls.does: Erases the jet's secret data.

controls.label: HMD BRT
controls.name: Helmet display brightness
controls.does: Steps the helmet display's brightness.

controls.label: HMD
controls.name: Helmet-mounted display
controls.does: Turns the helmet's display on and sets it for day or night. The F-35 has no head-up display: the helmet shows the flight and weapon symbols.

controls.label: VIDEO BRT
controls.name: Helmet video brightness
controls.does: Steps the brightness of the helmet's night picture.

controls.label: VIDEO CONT
controls.name: Helmet video contrast
controls.does: Steps the contrast of the helmet's night picture.

controls.label: DAY / NIGHT
controls.name: Display mode
controls.does: Sets the display for day or night.

controls.label: MFD BRT
controls.name: Display brightness
controls.does: Steps the panoramic display's brightness.

controls.label: COM A
controls.name: Radio A volume
controls.does: Sets the first radio's volume.

controls.label: COM B
controls.name: Radio B volume
controls.does: Sets the second radio's volume.

controls.label: COM C
controls.name: Radio C volume
controls.does: Sets the third audio channel's volume.

controls.label: MASTER ARM
controls.name: Master arm
controls.does: ARM lets weapons leave the jet; SAFE holds them.

controls.label: Standby display
controls.name: Electronic standby instrument
controls.does: A small display with its own sensors: attitude, speed, altitude and heading when the main display fails.

controls.label: ALIGN
controls.name: Standby display align
controls.does: Starts the standby display's alignment.

controls.label: BRT
controls.name: Standby display brightness
controls.does: Steps the standby display's brightness.

controls.label: BARO
controls.name: Standby display pressure setting
controls.does: Sets the pressure the standby altitude is measured from.

controls.label: Stick
controls.name: Side stick
controls.does: Commands pitch and roll through the flight control system.
controls.sim: Moves with the flight controls; its buttons have keys, the pointer does not work them.

controls.label: STICK
controls.name: Stick active or backup
controls.does: Chooses the stick's normal or backup channel.

controls.label: MDC
controls.name: Miniature detonating cord handle
controls.does: Shatters the canopy from inside, to leave the jet on the ground.

controls.label: Ejection handle
controls.name: Ejection handle
controls.does: Pulled, fires the seat.

controls.label: SEAT
controls.name: Seat safe and arm
controls.does: SAFE keeps the seat from firing.

controls.label: Seat height
controls.name: Seat height
controls.does: Raises and lowers the seat.

controls.label: PEDAL ADJ
controls.name: Pedal adjust
controls.does: Frees the pedals to move nearer or farther.
